title: Lie to me: Detecting Managerial Evasiveness in Earnings Calls via Conversational Audio Encoders
abstract: arXiv:2609.13893v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Earnings conference calls are a primary channel through which managers disclose information under analyst scrutiny. Prior work has linked vocal and lexical cues to future adverse outcomes, but often pools features over an entire call and underuses the interactive structure of Q&A. We propose a two-branch late-fusion framework for detecting managerial evasiveness as a predictor of extrinsic SEC events (primarily late filings): (i) an LLM-as-a-judge that maps Q&A text to an interpretable call-level vector X_text via a structured binary rubric, and (ii) a frozen conversational encoder whose temporal hidden states are read by a DeepVoice-style sequential reader to produce an audio representation h. Late fusion of (X_text, h) yields a call-level risk score p. translated_title: 《对我撒谎：利用对话式音频编码器检测财报电话会议中的管理层回避行为》
translated_abstract: 财报电话会议是管理层在分析师监督下披露信息的主要渠道。以往的研究已将声音和词汇线索与未来不良后果联系起来，但往往将特征汇聚于整场电话会议，且未充分利用问答环节的互动结构。我们提出了一个双分支后期融合框架，用于检测管理层回避行为，以此预测外部SEC事件（主要为延迟申报）：（i）一个“LLM作为评委”模块，通过结构化二元评分标准将问答文本映射为可解释的会议级向量X_text；（ii）一个冻结的对话式编码器，其时序隐藏状态由DeepVoice风格的序列读取器处理，生成音频表示h。对(X_text, h)进行后期融合可得到会议级风险评分p。在n=1,039通电话（含212次延迟申报）且按公司分组的5折交叉验证中，融合模型达到约0.89的AUROC，而文本评委仅为0.55，仅用通话时长为0.71。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种双分支后期融合框架，将LLM评委对问答文本的结构化分析与冻结对话式音频编码器的时序声学特征相结合，从财报电话会议中检测管理层回避行为并预测SEC延迟申报事件，融合模型AUROC达0.89，远超单一文本或时长基线。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-branch late-fusion framework combining an LLM-as-a-judge for structured Q&A text analysis and a frozen conversational audio encoder to detect managerial evasiveness in earnings calls, achieving an AUROC of 0.89 in predicting SEC late filing events—substantially outperforming text-only or duration-only baselines.
